items.name: Claude Code
items.description: Claude Code plugin that emits a signed Agent Manifest and TRACE record per session and detects agent composition drift from an approved baseline.

items.name: Codex
items.description: Codex plugin that fingerprints agent configuration, detects workspace-scoped drift, and emits signed Agent Manifest and TRACE Level 0 records.

items.name: LangChain
items.description: Emits a TRACE Trust Record from LangChain callbacks, including LangGraph tool runs, with tool identity but no payloads.

items.name: LlamaIndex
items.description: Emits a TRACE Trust Record from LlamaIndex instrumentation events, reading an allow-list so payloads cannot leak.

items.name: OpenShell TRACE Adapter
items.description: Builds a software-only TRACE record from NVIDIA OpenShell OCSF events and AGT ACS policy decisions.

items.name: OpenTelemetry GenAI
items.description: Builds a TRACE Trust Record from OpenTelemetry GenAI spans, marked as an unsigned telemetry import.

items.name: Agent Passport System
items.description: Maps one Ed25519-signed Agent Passport System policy decision onto a TRACE Trust Record, refusing decisions that fail signature or expiry verification.

items.name: Agent Sentinel
items.description: Runtime enforcement sidecar for agent fleets: detectors for delegation escalation, tool and identity drift, and policy avoidance, emitting Ed25519-signed TRACE Level 0 records.

items.name: Agentic SpendGuard
items.description: Spend firewall for LLM agents that reserves budget and gates tool calls before the provider is called, with a signed, hash-chained decision record.

items.name: Azure Secure Key Release
items.description: Translates a WCM release policy into an Azure Managed HSM Secure Key Release policy, and maps verified MAA claims into WCM composite evidence.

items.name: cA2A Cross-Operator Delegation
items.description: Runnable 12-check tutorial for scoped delegation, local policy enforcement, sealed tasks, tamper detection, and offline provenance verification.

items.name: comply54
items.description: Converts a comply54 ComplianceResult into a signed TRACE v0.1 JWT, mapping African regulatory policy decisions to verifiable attestation claims.

items.name: Confidential Containers Trustee
items.description: Generates a Confidential Containers Trustee Rego resource policy and key resource layout from a WCM manifest, preferring the vTPM claim path.

items.name: DecisionAssure
items.description: Converts a DecisionAssure runtime governance trace into a TRACE v0.2 Trust Record, marked as third-party-asserted.

items.name: EPI Recorder
items.description: Seals a portable .epi evidence file and emits a TRACE v0.2 log-import Trust Record (Level 0) via epi export trace; .epi hash is the transcript.

items.name: GCP Confidential Space
items.description: Generates a GCP Confidential Space workload identity attribute condition from a WCM manifest, comparing accepted measurements against the container image digest.

items.name: Google ADK
items.description: Emits a TRACE Trust Record from Google ADK callbacks using callback-visible tool and model identity without payloads.

items.name: Hugging Face Download Gate
items.description: Refuses a Hugging Face model snapshot whose bytes do not hash to the weights_hash bound by a jointly-signed WCM manifest shipped in the repository.

items.name: Nobulex
items.description: Emits Ed25519-signed JCS-canonical action receipts; each carries action_ref = SHA-256(JCS({agent_id, action_type, scope, timestamp_ms})) usable as TRACE external execution evidence (trace-spec #34).

items.name: NVIDIA GPU Attestation
items.description: Adapts NVIDIA nvattest evidence and appraisal into a WCM GpuReport, refusing unless every RIM, nonce and live certificate check passed.

items.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
items.description: Emits a first-party TRACE Trust Record from OpenAI Agents SDK tracing, carrying tool and handoff identity with no payloads.

items.name: ramen-ai cMCP Adapter
items.description: TRACE v0.2 exporter that verifies V5 Ed25519 receipts produced by the ramen-ai cMCP adapter and emits a natively signed software-only Trust Record.

items.name: SAGE AgenTrust Bridge
items.description: Reverse proxy that edge-verifies a TRACE record (key-equal) or cMCP RuntimeClaim (gateway-asserted) before admitting a memory submit to a stock, unmodified SAGE consensus-memory node.

items.name: Scheduled Agents
items.description: Claude Code plugin that fingerprints scheduled-agent routine specs and auto-run hooks, warns when what runs without you watching drifts from an approved baseline, and emits a signed TRACE record.

items.name: Shadow AI Discovery
items.description: Detects unregistered agents making MCP tool calls not declared in a cmcp catalog.json, emitting DiscoveryEvents that map to Agent Manifest records for remediation or quarantine.

items.name: SOVP
items.description: Maps a SOVP attestation result onto an Ed25519-signed AgenTrust TRACE Trust Record, signing only the fields the caller supplies and inferring no claims.

items.name: Triton Repository Staging
items.description: Prepares a Triton model repository under WCM attestation, verifying decrypted bytes against the bound weights hash before Triton can load them.

items.name: vLLM Serving Guard
items.description: Gates vLLM weight loading on WCM attestation, binds serving to a live lease, and emits a signed hash-chained runtime record of the lease lifecycle.

items.name: WCM Agent Manifest Binding
items.description: Binds an Agent Manifest model_identity artifact to a WCM manifest's weights hash, and reports what a matching digest does and does not establish.

items.name: WCM CycloneDX ML-BOM
items.description: Exports a WCM manifest as a CycloneDX 1.6 machine-learning-model component so custody terms reach licence review and procurement tooling.

items.name: WCM in-toto Attestation
items.description: Wraps a signed WCM manifest as an in-toto Statement v1 so custody terms ride existing supply-chain tooling, and verifies the subject binding on the way back.

items.name: WCM Kyverno Policy Pack
items.description: Generates a Kyverno ClusterPolicy enforcing the deployment preconditions a WCM manifest implies, and states in the policy what admission cannot verify.

items.name: WCM OCI Referrer
items.description: Attaches a signed WCM manifest to a model artifact as an OCI v1.1 referrer, and grades how strongly the referrer binds to the actual weight bytes.

items.name: WCM OpenTelemetry
items.description: Emits WCM key release decisions and runtime custody state as OpenTelemetry spans and metrics under a documented wcm.* attribute set.

items.name: WCM to TRACE
items.description: Turns a WCM Layer 2 release decision and a signed Layer 3 runtime record chain into TRACE v0.2 Trust Records, deriving assurance from what actually verified.

items.name: A2A AgentMesh
items.description: A2A protocol bridge for AgentMesh : trust-verified agent-to-agent communication via the A2A standard
